name: CNC Vertical Machining Center: start-up, set-up and run

steps.title: Main isolator ON
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the main isolator switch to ON.
steps.rationale: The isolator connects the machine to mains power. Nothing works without it.

steps.title: Release E-STOP
steps.spokenInstruction: Release the red emergency stop button.
steps.rationale: The machine cannot power up while the emergency stop is pressed in.

steps.title: Power ON
steps.spokenInstruction: Press the green POWER button.
steps.rationale: This starts the control system and the axis drives.

steps.title: Select HOME mode
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the mode selector to HOME.
steps.rationale: Homing is only possible in HOME mode.

steps.title: Home Z first
steps.spokenInstruction: Press HOME Z. The spindle will rise to its top position.
steps.rationale: Z must go first so the tool is lifted clear before the table moves.

steps.title: Home X and Y
steps.spokenInstruction: Now press HOME XY. The table will move to its home position.
steps.rationale: Homing XY before Z can drag the tool across the table and crash it.

steps.title: Select tool T1
steps.spokenInstruction: Press TOOL until T1 is selected.
steps.rationale: The program expects tool T1 in the spindle.

steps.title: Open the door
steps.spokenInstruction: Open the machine door.
steps.rationale: You need access to the table to load the part.

steps.title: Place the workpiece
steps.spokenInstruction: Place the workpiece in the vise.
steps.rationale: The part sits on the table between the vise jaws.

steps.title: Clamp the workpiece
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the clamp handle to lock the workpiece.
steps.rationale: An unclamped part can be thrown out of the machine during cutting.

steps.title: Close the door
steps.spokenInstruction: Close the machine door.
steps.rationale: The cycle will not start with the door open, and the door protects you from chips.

steps.title: Select program O1001
steps.spokenInstruction: Press PROGRAM until O1001 is selected.
steps.rationale: O1001 is the program written for this part and tool.

steps.title: Select DRY mode
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the mode selector to DRY.
steps.rationale: A dry run proves the path in the air before any metal is cut.

steps.title: Set feed to 50 percent
steps.spokenInstruction: Set the feed override to 50 percent.
steps.rationale: Slow motion gives you time to stop the machine if something looks wrong.

steps.title: Run the dry cycle
steps.spokenInstruction: Press CYCLE START and watch the dry run until it finishes.
steps.rationale: Never cut the first part without a dry run.

steps.title: Select AUTO mode
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the mode selector to AUTO.
steps.rationale: AUTO runs the program for real production.

steps.title: Set feed to 100 percent
steps.spokenInstruction: Set the feed override back to 100 percent.
steps.rationale: Production runs at full programmed feed.

steps.title: Coolant ON
steps.spokenInstruction: Press COOLANT to turn the coolant on.
steps.rationale: Cutting without coolant overheats and ruins the tool.

steps.title: Run the production cycle
steps.spokenInstruction: Press CYCLE START and let the part finish.
steps.rationale: This is the real cut, with coolant on and full feed.

steps.title: Open the door
steps.spokenInstruction: Open the machine door.
steps.rationale: You can only reach the finished part with the door open.

steps.title: Remove the part
steps.spokenInstruction: Take the finished part out of the vise.
steps.rationale: The machine must be empty before shutdown.

steps.title: Power OFF
steps.spokenInstruction: Press POWER to switch the machine off.
steps.rationale: Always power down after the job.
